sem-1.title: Source reasoning: Retrieve and locate
body: What is the author claiming? What supports it? What does it not establish?

sem-2.title: Source reasoning: Locate the task
body: Paragraph /4: claim, support, inference, limit.
P2/P5/P7: paragraph + decision exit (/4 each).
P6/P8: one source-reasoning score /4.
Decision exit (P2/P5/P7), one point each:
1. Shows the sentence that changed
2. Says what the partner's check found
3. Explains one choice in the revision
4. Checks the changed sentence against the source

sem-3.title: Source reasoning: Read the common passage
body: Goldsmith, "Go Ahead: Waste Time on the Internet" (2016), paragraphs 4 to 7.
Mark claim, example and inference.
Treat the passage as a historical argument, not a current scientific finding.

sem-4.title: Source reasoning: Model the reasoning
body: Observation → inference → scope.

sem-5.title: Source reasoning: Test the inference
body: Which conclusion exceeds the evidence?
A: Some device use includes sustained reading.
B: The passage challenges a blanket claim.
C: Devices improve concentration for all users.

sem-6.title: Source reasoning: Transfer to students' own sources
body: Check credibility and relevance.
Who produced it? What supports trust?
Why does it fit? What needs checking?
Write: claim, support, explanation, limit.
Keep the source open.

sem-7.title: Source reasoning: Peer check and revise
body: Keep the paragraph before the check.
Point to evidence. Test the explanation and limit.
Identify a specific issue or strength.
Revise a sentence and explain the source-based reason.

sem-8.title: Source reasoning: Exit and next lesson
body: Show the sentence that changed.
Say what the partner's check found.
Explain one choice in the revision.
Check the changed sentence against the source.
P2/P5/P7: exit /4. P6/P8: paragraph /4.

w1.en: I name the author's claim and what supports it.
w1.es: Nombro la afirmación del autor y lo que la apoya.

w1.en: I explain the inference and say what the source does not establish.
w1.es: Explico la inferencia y digo lo que la fuente no establece.

w1.en: I check who produced my source and why it fits my question.
w1.es: Reviso quién produjo mi fuente y por qué encaja con mi pregunta.

claim.def_en: What the author says is true.
claim.def_es: Lo que el autor dice que es cierto.

support.def_en: The evidence or reasons behind a claim.
support.def_es: La evidencia o las razones detrás de una afirmación.

inference.def_en: A conclusion drawn from the evidence.
inference.def_es: Una conclusión que se saca de la evidencia.

limit.def_es: Lo que la evidencia no puede mostrar.

scope.def_en: Who and what a conclusion covers.
scope.def_es: A quién y a qué cubre una conclusión.

credibility.def_es: Razones para confiar en una fuente.

relevance.def_en: How well a source fits your question.
relevance.def_es: Qué tan bien encaja una fuente con tu pregunta.

attribution.def_en: Saying which source an idea comes from.
attribution.def_es: Decir de qué fuente viene una idea.

synthesis.def_en: Connecting sources to explain something new.
synthesis.def_es: Conectar fuentes para explicar algo nuevo.

perspective.def_en: A point of view on an issue.
perspective.def_es: Un punto de vista sobre un tema.

record.def_en: One documented observation or entry in your data.
record.def_es: Una observación o entrada documentada en tus datos.

reference.def_es: El tiempo que describe un registro.

method.def_en: How you will collect and analyze evidence.
method.def_es: Cómo vas a recolectar y analizar la evidencia.

feedback.def_en: Comments on your work that guide revision.
feedback.def_es: Comentarios sobre tu trabajo que guían la revisión.

revision.def_en: A change to your work, with a reason.
revision.def_es: Un cambio en tu trabajo, con una razón.

steps.cue: Read the target and the why aloud.
Start the do-now timer. Silent start.
Point to the clock times and the work modes.
Students check these again at the exit.
Core first. Open supported or extension for students who need it.
The exit goes in the student's own document. If not reached, it returns as next class's do-now.
Absent students: print the absent sheet from Tools.
